integrity: The finite optimization is exhaustive after the published reduction. A bundled standalone verifier reconstructs all reduced states and directly checks explicit attaining codes by proper-prefix/proper-suffix disjointness. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The claim is restricted to fixed length six and alphabet sizes 7, 8, and 9. It does not give an all-q formula, enumerate maximum-code isomorphism classes, or reprove the published structural reduction used for the upper bound.
title: Exact length-six non-overlapping code maxima at alphabet sizes \(7,8,9\)
